instructions_to_main_agent: TECH STACK: React, Tailwind CSS, Shadcn UI, lucide-react.

EDITOR: Integrate a robust Notion-like WYSIWYG editor. Highly recommend `@blocknote/react`, `novel`, or standard `tiptap` with markdown support. It must support inline rendering and slash commands if possible.
DATA LAYER: This app has NO BACKEND. Use the browser's `localStorage` to persist Workspaces, Folders, Notes, and Tags. Ensure state updates synchronously.

LAYOUT: Build a 100vh app wrapper. Sidebar fixed on left (collapsible via hamburger on mobile). Main editor area takes remaining space. Limit the editor max-width to 4xl (896px) and center it for optimal reading, just like Notion.
UI FEEL: Keep it strictly 'Notion style'. Very minimal, stark white (#FFFFFF) editor surface, and off-white/gray (#F7F7F5) sidebar. Do NOT use dark heavy shadows. Use soft, almost invisible borders.

FEATURES: Sidebar must show nested folders or flat workspaces with notes under them. Implement Cmd+K (using Shadcn Command Dialog) for global search across all notes. Implement a Tag system with soft pastel colors (refer to tags palette).
PAGE ASSETS: Allow users to add a Cover Image to notes. Use the URLs from `default_covers` in this JSON as pre-defined choices or randomized default assignments.
TYPOGRAPHY: Import and use `Outfit` for headings and `Figtree` for body text. Headings must be tight (`tracking-tight`).
TESTING: MUST include `data-testid` on all interactive elements (buttons, sidebar items, note titles, editor area) for testing purposes.
